subject: progress bar doesn't work on server

messages.author: aed33d140f600131
messages.subject: progress bar doesn't work on server
parts:
Hi,

I have implemented a shiny app which runs on my local computer as well as on a server. Everything works fine. Recently, I have included a progress bar in my shiny app. Since the time consuming calculations are in my function myfun(a,b,c,uP=NULL), the Progress object (defined in the server.R-file) is updated in my function. I followed the example in http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/progress.html. This works really fine on my local computer. Unfortunately my shiny app has to run on the server, where the same code with the progress bar throws an error:

Error in myfun(a=input$a,b=input$b, : unused argument (uP= updateProgress).

shiny 0.10.2 is used on both local comuter and server. so it doesn't seem to be a problem of different versions. I can't understand why exactly the same code works locally fine but doesn't work on the server. Please can anyone give me a hint what can be wrong?

Thanks
Birgit

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: progress bar doesn't work on server
parts: It looks like the copy of myfun on the server has a different signature. Can you make absolutely sure you have the same code running in both places? Is there an .RData file that's hidden in that directory that could be interfering?
